description: Frozen SQL result-shape set for the candidate SQL configurations (17 questions). Written on 2026-11-09 after the Candidate v2.1 failure analysis, to measure the failure classes it exposed (extra or missing output columns, a table-wide instead of a per-entity latest value, the population of 'for each'), and without sight of any v2.2 or v2.3 output. It contains no official, unseen (U) or independent benchmark (D/V/T) question and none of the few-shot examples shown to the model. It is NOT a blind set: the failure classes were known when it was written. Every reference result was executed on the reference database and independently recomputed with pandas from the supplied CSV files; the two agree. Scored strictly with the unchanged official comparator; relaxed matches are reported separately. Never read by runtime code and never copied into a prompt.

cases.category: Scalar aggregate; join and filter columns are not output
cases.question: What is the highest beta recorded for the Growth Equity Fund?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(r.beta) FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Growth Equity Fund';

cases.category: Latest date per entity (not the table-wide maximum)
cases.question: What is the date of the most recent transaction in the Growth Equity Fund?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(t.transaction_date) FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Growth Equity Fund';

cases.category: Latest value per entity, value only
cases.question: What is the most recent tracking error for the Balanced Portfolio?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.tracking_error FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Balanced Portfolio' ORDER BY r.calculation_date DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.category: Scalar aggregate over a three-table join
cases.question: What is the total cost basis of the Energy holdings across all portfolios?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(h.cost_basis) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Energy';

cases.category: Top-1 with the requested attributes named
cases.question: Give the symbol and current price of the most expensive bond.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT symbol, current_price FROM securities WHERE asset_type = 'Bond' ORDER BY current_price DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.category: Attribute list; filter column is not output
cases.question: List the name and creation date of every active portfolio.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT portfolio_name, creation_date FROM portfolios WHERE status = 'Active';

cases.category: Holdings record listing with no columns named (the convention used by official Q5)
cases.question: Show me the top 3 holdings by quantity in the Small Cap Value Fund.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT h.holding_id, s.symbol, s.company_name, h.quantity FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Small Cap Value Fund' ORDER BY h.quantity DESC LIMIT 3;
cases.convention: Same reference convention as official Q5: a holdings listing returns the holding's identity (holding_id, symbol, company_name), its quantity, and the measure the list is ranked by when that is not the quantity. Q5 ranks by cost_basis, so it carries cost_basis; this question ranks by quantity, which is already returned.

cases.category: Attribute list, one named attribute (convention used by unseen U4: symbol identifies a security)
cases.question: List each Financials stock with its listing date.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.symbol, s.listing_date FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Financials' AND s.asset_type = 'Stock';
cases.convention: Same reference convention as unseen U4: a security is identified by symbol, without company_name.

cases.category: Group count: the group key and the count
cases.question: How many portfolios are there for each status?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM portfolios GROUP BY status;

cases.category: Group sum: the group key and the sum
cases.question: What is the total stated AUM of the portfolios at each target risk level?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT target_risk_level, SUM(total_aum) FROM portfolios GROUP BY target_risk_level;

cases.category: Share of a total: one percentage
cases.question: What percentage of all securities are bonds?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN asset_type = 'Bond' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM securities;

cases.category: Rank and take the top row; the single requested attribute only
cases.question: Which sector has the highest total market cap among its stocks? Give the sector name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sec.sector_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE s.asset_type = 'Stock' GROUP BY sec.sector_name ORDER BY SUM(s.market_cap) DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.category: Distinct entity names through a join; the join columns are not output
cases.question: List the names of the portfolios that hold at least one bond.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id WHERE s.asset_type = 'Bond';

cases.category: Requested attribute named, filter on a portfolio name
cases.question: Which securities are held in the Emerging Markets Fund? Give their symbols.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.symbol FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Emerging Markets Fund';

cases.category: Count with a date-year filter; only the count
cases.question: How many transactions did the Tech Innovation Fund make in 2023?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Tech Innovation Fund' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';

cases.category: Average of one attribute for a sector
cases.question: What is the average current price of the Healthcare stocks?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(s.current_price) FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Healthcare' AND s.asset_type = 'Stock';

cases.category: Per-entity share of a total (population rule: sectors that have securities, as official Q7)
cases.question: For each sector, show the number of securities and what percentage of all securities it represents.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sec.sector_name, COUNT(*) AS security_count, 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities) AS percentage FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY sec.sector_name;
cases.convention: Population follows official Q7: only sectors that have matching securities are listed.

revisions.change: reference corrected before any model answer was recorded: the first reference also returned cost_basis, which is not the ranked measure under Q5's convention. Found by an offline check of the reference SQL against the v2.3 shape policy; the corrected form follows Q5's convention as stated above.
